key_drivers.name: China keeps benchmark lending rates unchanged
key_drivers.observed: China kept the one-year LPR at 3.00% and five-year LPR at 3.50% for September, the 16th consecutive monthly hold. Reuters reported the decision matched a unanimous poll of 21 market participants.
key_drivers.interpretation: No fresh broad monetary-easing impulse for China-linked demand; this is a policy-background input rather than a direct Taiwan earnings shock.

key_drivers.interpretation: Russia-Ukraine refined-product and war-risk pressure remains elevated, but no additional outage volume is inferred.

key_drivers.interpretation: The chokepoint tail-risk is below its earlier peak, but Saudi/Houthi escalation continues to support energy and freight risk premia.
